english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for putting seeds or plants into soil so they can grow.
Use 種 as the all-purpose verb for growing or planting crops and other plants.
Use this when someone cultivates or grows plants, crops, or vegetables.

examples.english: We plant herbs on the balcony today.
examples.traditional: 我哋今日喺露台種香草。
